svg.title: Personal AI OS — certification battery
svg.desc: Test fixtures certify each autonomy level from L0 to L4. A failed fixture caps the runtime at the highest fully-passed level; results and dates go in the runtime profile and the human flips the active profile.
svg.text: Autonomy is granted by passing fixtures — a failure caps you at the last level cleared

g.text: all lower levels + 13 vault-import + supervised migration on a copy
01 duplicate-proposal (as proposal) · drafts land correctly in Inbox
04 privacy-exclusion · 09 read-refusal · honest abstention on retrieval
